checkpoints.detail: MHS is an MCP connector, experimental and disabled by default (rows listed, connector disabled, no endpoint connection)
operator enabled the experimental MCP integration for this demo
one host discovered 5 devices, 27 capabilities, modes=['simulated'], fidelity gaps disclosed
conveyor, pipette, sample mover, plate reader and arm are all addressable
read pipette, mover, reader, conveyor and arm state
pipette A1->B1 25 uL, plate moved to reader, absorbance measured on B1
permit-gated diverter actuation completed (the operator route issued the MHS permit)
2-DOF arm moved to joint positions [25, 40] deg
lost receipt produced an unknown receipt; state re-read before any retry
e-stop receipt 01M5JKBN9Y60TC042CSEVZCNMZ chained; next actuation refused with MHS.SAFETY.ESTOP_ENGAGED; reset restored operation
27 capability tools, each bound to one device; no generic hardware-control tool; permits gate the actuation
same lab endpoint via MCPManager: mhs__lab_liquid_handler__fluid_transfer returned the native command_id 01M5JKBN9CAHDARE1NR948NCCX
